name: maximum-output-breakthrough
intent: Output meter charges from 0% to explicit NOMINAL 100%, then tears past the track to 108% with a frozen jagged burst polygon.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Immediately show 108% MAX+ with burst polygon at final position

Breakthrough fills 0→100% over 580ms then breaks to 108% with frozen burst clip-path
Completion shows MAX+ label and breakthrough live announcement
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows 108% breakthrough immediately
No network; burst geometry matches contract clip-path
